english.note: Use this colloquial term for a person who idles and lives off their family or others, rather than for an animal parasite.

exampleSentences.english: They stay at home all day doing nothing and live off their family—they’re really a parasite.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日匿喺屋企唔做嘢，靠屋企人養，真係個米蟲。
